notes: New: Hide the age gate on specific pages or posts — open any Page or Blog Post, go to SEO > Advanced, and check "Hide Age Gate" (no Custom JS needed). There's also a blanket "Hide on all blog content" toggle in Site Settings > Age Gate to exclude the whole blog section in one switch. New: Parent Page support — pages can now nest under one another, producing URLs like /specials/piner-road. Pick a parent from the new dropdown on any page, and the full URL is generated automatically; renaming a parent's slug cascades to every child page's URL, and the Pages list shows the hierarchy at a glance.
New: FlexiBuilder's Blocks panel now has a search box, WordPress-style — filter the full block library by name instead of scrolling through categories, with results updating as you type.

New: llms.txt support — your site now serves a curated summary for AI/LLM crawlers at yourdomain.com/llms.txt, following the emerging llms.txt convention. It's auto-generated from your site name, tagline, description, and published pages/posts, or you can write fully custom content instead. Configure it in Site Settings > SEO, with an Enabled/Disabled toggle and an optional custom content field.

New: Blog Settings > SEO & Social now has a Schema Markup field for the blog listing page, matching the JSON-LD option already available on individual posts and pages. Fix: JSON-LD schema markup (Schema Markup field) on posts and pages was rendering HTML-escaped quotes instead of real ones, producing invalid structured data that search engines couldn't parse correctly — this has been broken since the feature was introduced and is now fixed across posts, pages, and the new blog listing field.

New: Blog Settings — a "Comment form on posts" toggle in Single Post Elements lets you turn the comments section (existing comments and the submission form) off entirely for a post's single page. Fix: the comments section and form now have proper CSS classes (.post-comments, .comment-form, .comment-item, etc.) so they can be custom-styled — previously there was no class or ID to hook into. Fix: saving a blog post with an excerpt between 256-500 characters caused a server error instead of saving — the database column was too small for the validation rule that allowed it. Fixed the column size and added a live character counter on the Excerpt field so authors see the limit as they type. Fix: the Age Gate's "Are you 21+?" heading was marked up as an <h2>, creating a duplicate, out-of-place heading on every single page of the site (bad for SEO). It's now a styled paragraph instead, with no visual change.

Fix: FlexiBuilder's Content editor (the text/heading Settings panel) was rendering typed HTML like
and as literal escaped text instead of real markup, and pressing Enter for a new line had no visual effect — content is now parsed as real HTML and line breaks are preserved. Fix: reselecting a component that already had rich formatting (bold, links, etc.) showed plain unformatted text in the Content panel, which could silently erase that formatting on the next edit — content now round-trips correctly. Fix: a database migration for the Deals multi-day feature used a column type rejected by strict MySQL installs (it only worked on MariaDB, which most cPanel hosts use by default) — fresh installs on MySQL no longer fail during setup.

Fix: CSS duplication from site migration — pages imported via .pagezy backup that contained accumulated duplicate :root{} blocks now render with a single clean CSS block automatically. No re-save needed. Fix: CSS deduplication now runs at runtime in GlobalTemplateService so migrated sites are fixed immediately on next page load. New: CSS Cleanup Tool — one-click button on Tools → Changelog that permanently deduplicates CSS in all pages, posts, and popups in the database. New: Performance settings group in Global Settings — Minify CSS (strips comments and whitespace from inline style blocks), Minify JS (strips block comments and collapses whitespace in inline scripts), and Remove Unused CSS (drops class/ID rules with no matching element in the page HTML). All three default to Disabled and can be toggled independently.

Fix: CSS variables (e.g. --gradient-color) were duplicating on every FlexiBuilder save — each save added another copy of :root {} rules causing bloated CSS. Fix: Custom Code blocks were losing <script> tags on save/reload — GrapesJS was silently stripping scripts during HTML parsing. Fix: Custom Code blocks were losing <style> tags on save/reload — the page-level style extraction was incorrectly removing styles that belonged to Custom Code blocks. Fix: Global Elements (Headers, Footers) list page was throwing a 500 error for records where updated_at was null. New: Blog Banner — Advanced panel with Custom Class, Custom ID, Custom CSS, and Custom HTML fields for full banner customisation without touching theme files.

Fix: Popup edit page was throwing a 500 error when updated_at was null for older records. Fix: Contact page now always loads from the CMS FlexiBuilder page (slug: contact) instead of the built-in default theme view. Fix: [form id="X"] shortcodes now render correctly inside FlexiBuilder pages and global header/footer templates. Fix: Forms in global header/footer templates now submit correctly via AJAX. Fix: All Swiper sliders (Hero, RSS, Banner, Feature, Content Carousel) no longer break when Theme JS/CSS is set to Disabled in Global Elements — Swiper always loads independently. Fix: Additional CSS gradient rules in FlexiBuilder now take effect correctly — inline background styles are stripped before injecting the CSS rule so the gradient wins. New: Content Carousel block — drag it from the Templates panel to get a Swiper carousel where each slide is a fully droppable container (add any block inside each slide). New: Google Maps embeds are now editable in FlexiBuilder — select the map, open the Settings panel, and paste a new Google Maps embed URL or change the height. Works for the Embed Map block, Contact Section template, and Footer template. New: FlexiBuilder — Background Image Overlay color picker with opacity slider in the Settings panel. New: FlexiBuilder — Form Settings panel for configuring form action, method, and field options directly in the builder. New: Visual Editor (blog/pages) upgraded to TinyMCE — full toolbar with styles, tables, media, emoticons, find & replace, and more. New: Visual Editor toolbar expanded with H1–H6 headings, font size, subscript/superscript, indent controls, and background color. Fix: Media Library modal now has a sticky header and scrollable grid, correct z-index (99999), and is appended to document.body to prevent stacking context issues from CSS transforms.

New: FlexiBuilder — images can now be linked. Select any image to see the Link panel in the Settings tab: enter a URL to wrap the image in an <a> tag, edit the URL to update it, or click Remove Link to unwrap it. Open-in-new-tab supported. New: Navigation menus now support a Header Right location alongside Header Left (Primary Navigation) — create two independent header menus for left and right sides. Fix: Broken link checker now also scans navigation menu item URLs and Global Template (header/footer) HTML, not just page and post body content.

Fix: Broken link checker now detects internal broken links correctly — validates against CMS page/post slugs in the database instead of making HTTP requests (which followed server redirects and returned false 200s for links like /about.html). New: Popup settings — Custom CSS field, scoped automatically to each popup (.cms-popup-overlay, .cms-popup-box, .cms-popup-close are auto-prefixed with the popup ID). New: Popup settings — Close button customisation: position (Inside Top-Right, Inside Top-Left, Outside Top-Right), label/symbol (✕ ✖ × or custom text), icon colour, background colour and opacity. Fix: Adding an entrance animation to a popup no longer makes the popup content invisible — animations are now triggered explicitly when the popup opens (IntersectionObserver timing fix). Fix: Additional CSS panel in FlexiBuilder Settings tab was collapsing to zero height and disappearing — layout bug fixed, panel now appears reliably when any element is selected. Run php artisan migrate after updating.

Hotfix: creating or saving a popup with the FlexiBuilder content type was throwing a 500 error (database column did not accept the 'flexibuilder' value). Run php artisan migrate after updating to apply the fix. Also adds a Link panel in FlexiBuilder Settings tab (URL + open-in-new-tab for buttons and links) and Age Gate quick-add class chips (age-gate-overlay, age-gate-modal, age-gate-yes, age-gate-no).

New: Client Preview System — share a token-based preview link with clients so they can leave pin-drop comments anywhere on the page, reply in threads, mark issues as In Review or Resolved, and approve the design with one click. No login required for clients. New: FlexiBuilder Hover Effects — 12 presets (Lift, Scale Up, Glow, Shadow, BG Shift, Border Pop, Brighten, Dim, Rotate, Shrink, Fade, Underline) with duration control, active state, and a None option to remove effects cleanly. Fix: hover effects no longer stack — selecting a new effect or None now correctly replaces the previous one on the public page. Fix: clicking an element in FlexiBuilder now automatically opens the Settings tab. Fix: Gradient and FX toolbar buttons removed (were non-functional).

Fix: Global Sections now render with correct colours and styles on all pages — CSS is bundled at save time (including brand variables) and baked into inline styles so they work everywhere, even when added to the same page they were built on. Fix: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo now work correctly inside the FlexiBuilder canvas. Fix: Background CSS — added a free-text Background CSS field in the Style Manager for gradients and var() references; background:var() is now automatically normalised to background-color:var() so GrapeJS no longer drops it. Fix: Import HTML — relative image filenames (e.g. banner.jpg) are now automatically matched against your Media Library and replaced with full URLs on import. Fix: Import HTML — imported CSS styles now correctly appear in the Style Manager when you select elements (delay increased to allow GrapeJS to fully process the import). Improvement: Removed the ★ Block toolbar button (use right-click → Save as Global Section instead).

New: Image Path Resolver — paste HTML with bare filenames (e.g. hero.jpg) anywhere in the admin and they're automatically matched against your Media Library and replaced with the correct full URL. Works in Age Gate Custom HTML, Popup editor, FlexiBuilder HTML Import, and the new standalone Import HTML tool. New: Admin → Import HTML tool — dedicated page to paste raw HTML, resolve image paths, and copy cleaned output. New: Admin → Changelog — view full version history bundled with your install. Fix: FlexiBuilder style state selector (:hover / :focus / :active) moved from top toolbar into the Styles panel sidebar.

Fix: Age Gate FlexiBuilder save 500 error (DB column expanded to LONGTEXT — run php artisan migrate after update). Fix: FlexiBuilder back button now saves before navigating. Fix: FlexiBuilder autosave now writes to DB every 30 seconds. Fix: Age Gate Custom HTML editor blank (replaced with native textarea). Fix: AVIF image uploads now accepted. Fix: button { cursor: pointer } added to theme.css. Fix: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo & redo wired to FlexiBuilder. New: Theme CSS and Theme JS 3-mode control in Site Settings — Load normally / Custom (edit inline) / Disabled. New: FlexiBuilder :hover / :focus / :active state switcher in toolbar. Improvement: editor type icons replaced with SVG (was emoji, broken on Windows). Improvement: Swiper console logs removed.
Improved: "Fix Image Storage" button now uses a PHP file-server as its final fallback — works on cPanel servers where Apache ignores FollowSymLinks even when it's in .htaccess.
Hotfix: Media images were 404 on cPanel even with a valid storage symlink. Fixed by adding Options +FollowSymLinks to public/.htaccess — cPanel Apache disables symlink-following by default.

Fix: "Fix Image Storage" button now has 3 fallback methods — works even on cPanel servers where symlink() is disabled. Falls back to a .htaccess rewrite rule that serves storage files without needing a symlink.
New: "Fix Image Storage" button in Media Library — click it if your uploaded images show as broken. Runs the storage symlink command automatically and reloads the page on success.
Hotfix: Media Library was crashing with a 500 error on installs where the pages table doesn't have the featured_image column yet. Update immediately if you're seeing this error.

Fix: import no longer crashes when the export file contains columns that don't exist on the destination database (schema version mismatch between stage and live). Unknown columns are silently skipped. Also adds a full-screen loading overlay during import.

Import now includes an optional Admin Users module. Unchecked by default — tick it only if you want to bring over admin accounts from the stage site. Your own login is always protected: even in Overwrite mode your account is never deleted or replaced.

Migration hardened for stage→live flow: URL rewriting now covers custom_js, site_variables, and block thumbnails. User IDs reassigned to importing admin. Cache cleared automatically. Server upload limit shown in drop zone. Better error messages for 413/419 responses.

Fix: migration import no longer destroys data if it fails mid-way (TRUNCATE → DELETE, fully transactional). Warning shown when importing Settings with Overwrite mode (SMTP and admin email will be replaced).
Fix: bug report screenshots now display correctly on cPanel. Fix: bug reports now forward to the central hub (CSRF was blocking the API endpoint).

Bug reports now work without SMTP — reports are forwarded to the central Pagezy hub via a secure API. Bug button always visible. Source site badge on each report. New public POST /api/bug-report endpoint.
Bug Reports sidebar link and floating button are now hidden when SMTP is not configured in Site Settings — no point showing the feature if emails can't be sent.
Fix: CMS update progress overlay now shows correctly — clicking "Update Now" now displays a full-screen step-by-step progress overlay instead of just the browser tab spinner.

Sidebar reorganised (7 clean sections, no duplicate labels). Age Gate moved to Global Hub. All SEO tools merged into "All Tools". Broken Link Checker now detects internal/relative links and correctly shows success state after a clean scan. Analytics chart height fixed. CMS update checker uses local RELEASES.json as authoritative version source. Sidebar brand name now reads from Site Settings.

New: SEO Audit — instant scoring of all pages/posts for title, description, H1, alt text, OG image. New: Broken Link Checker — AJAX-driven scan with live progress, results saved to DB. New: Page Speed & Web Vitals — local checks + optional Google Lighthouse scores (LCP, CLS, FCP, TBT).

New: Analytics dashboard with 30-day chart, top pages/posts, and GA4/GTM/GSC status links. New: Google Search Console verification meta tag field. Daily view tracking now records per-day history for historical charts.
New: {{section:slug}} shortcodes now show a live preview placeholder in FlexiBuilder canvas instead of raw text. The shortcode is preserved on save so the frontend still renders the full section.
Fixed: buttons used without the base btn class (common in FlexiBuilder pages) now render with correct padding, border-radius, and layout — not just colour.
Fixed: button text underline showing on pages that load Bootstrap CSS. All button variants now correctly suppress text-decoration regardless of other stylesheets on the page.
Fixed: Custom JS syntax errors no longer silently break the entire page. A clear console error is shown instead, and all other page scripts continue running normally.

Fixed: {{section:name}} shortcode now renders correctly on frontend pages and posts. New: Sections list now auto-displays the shortcode for each section with a Copy button — no more guessing the slug.

New: {{section:name}} shortcode — embed any Section template into pages, posts, or global templates. Fixed: Footer Code and Header Code now auto-execute raw JavaScript. Clearer Code Injection field hints.
Hotfix: Footer Code and Header Code now auto-execute raw JavaScript without needing <script> tags. Also: Search & Replace now searches per-page Custom CSS and Custom JS fields.
Hotfix: Custom Code JavaScript now supports $() and $$() helpers, matching browser DevTools behaviour. Scripts using $$() were failing silently before this update.
Hotfix: fixes button styles appearing broken after the v1.4.0 update due to browsers caching the old CSS. Update immediately if buttons on your site look broken.
Hotfix: fixes a 500 error on all frontend pages after the v1.4.0 update. Update immediately if you're seeing an Internal Server Error on your site.

New: Site Migration — export your entire site to a single .pagezy file and import it on any Pagezy server in one click (pages, posts, media, settings, menus, and more). New: HTML/ZIP Import into FlexiBuilder — upload any HTML template or ZIP archive directly into the page builder, images auto-uploaded to Media Library. New: Pages Quick Edit — edit title, slug, template, and status inline without opening the full editor. New: Button brand controls — set primary and secondary button colours in Brand & Design. Fixed: Deals settings crash, pages flash messages.
Bug fix: custom font upload (.otf/.ttf files now accepted). New: upload multiple font weights/styles (Regular, Bold, Italic) under one family name.
MySQL database backup (pure PHP, no exec needed), Search & Replace tool, FlexiBuilder canvas colour sync, and HTML export fix.
Swiper.js slider builder, scheduled publishing, analytics, saved blocks, blog comments, image focal point, page duplicate.
FlexiBuilder stability fix, UX improvements, author display name override.
Page module & FlexiBuilder bug fixes.
